Gautam Gambhir addresses Sanju Samson's exclusion from team

Former cricketer Gautam Gambhir has spoken about the decision to exclude Sanju Samson from a team. Gambhir stated he had a direct conversation with Samson regarding the matter. The details of this conversation were reportedly kept private.
